segments.name: LR2
segments.description: Operates Long Range II product tankers carrying clean petroleum oil products for charterers and pool participants worldwide.
segments.evidence: The LR2 segment consists of vessels between 85,000 DWT and 124,999 DWT in size and provides transportation of clean petroleum oil products.

segments.name: LR1
segments.description: Operates Long Range I tankers transporting clean and dirty petroleum products for charterers and pool participants worldwide.
segments.evidence: The LR1 segment consists of vessels between 55,000 DWT and 84,999 DWT in size and provides transportation of clean and dirty petroleum products.

segments.name: MR
segments.description: Operates Medium Range tankers carrying oil products, vegetable oil and easy chemicals for charterers and pool participants worldwide.
segments.evidence: The MR segment consists of vessels between 40,000 DWT and 54,999 DWT in size and provides transportation of clean and dirty oil products, vegetable oil and easy chemicals; inclusive of IMO II vessels.

segments.name: Handy
segments.description: Operates Handy size tankers carrying oil products, vegetable oil and easy chemicals for charterers and pool participants worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Handy segment consists of vessels between 25,000 DWT and 39,999 DWT in size and provides transportation of clean and dirty oil products, vegetable oil and easy chemicals; inclusive of IMO II vessels.

revenueModel.text: Charterers and pool participants pay us time charter and voyage charter hire for transporting oil products, vegetable oil and easy chemicals.
revenueModel.evidence: The vessels in our Hafnia Fleet primarily trade through our Pools; however, we charter certain Hafnia Vessels, JV Vessels and TC Vessels directly to customers on time charters or voyage charters.

changes.text: In 2023 the Group exited the Chemical-Stainless segment after disposing of the vessels acquired through the acquisition of Chemical Tankers Inc.
changes.evidence: During the financial year ended 31 December 2023, the group exited the Chemical-Stainless segment after disposing of its Chemical-Stainless vessels that were previously acquired through the acquisition of Chemical Tankers Inc.

changes.text: In 2023 the Group also exited the Specialised segment after redelivering its only Specialised vessel.
changes.evidence: the Group exited the Specialised segment after redelivering its only Specialised vessel.

changes.text: The previously separate Chemical-MR and Chemical-Handy segments were combined into the MR and Handy segments.
changes.evidence: Previously, we reported on "Chemical-MR" vessels and "Chemical-Handy" vessels as separate segments, however we have now grouped "Chemical-MR" and "Chemical-Handy" vessels under the MR segment and the Handy segment, respectively.
